result.summary: The page is largely well-designed and functional, but there are a few visual issues: horizontally scrollable content is clipped at the right edge without clear affordance, and the bottom navigation lacks a safe-area inset for the home indicator.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' horizontal card row and the category filter chips are clipped at the right screen edge (e.g. 'Trattoria Piccol...' and a partially visible chip), with no visible scroll indicator or fade/gradient hint that more content exists off-screen.
issues.suggestion: Add a right-edge fade gradient or peek of the next card, plus a subtle scroll indicator, so users understand these rows are horizontally scrollable.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar sits flush against the device home indicator with no safe-area padding, which can cause the labels/icons to feel cramped or be obscured on notched/gesture devices.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom safe-area inset padding to the tab bar so the home indicator does not overlap the navigation content.

issues.description: The notification bell icon in the top-right has a small red dot badge with no numeric count or text alternative, which may be unclear to screen-reader users.
issues.suggestion: Provide an accessible label such as 'Notifications, new alerts' and consider a count badge where relevant.
